out_of_schema_notes: Harvest runs no designed experiment: the three parameters were studied one factor at a time in S-HAR-UNI2 (made during the Version 2.0 re-analysis, PD-004-01), the report claims no design space, and no response-surface model was fitted. StatisticalModelFit holds the simple linear regressions of S-HAR-UNI2, one per row of the regression table, with the change over the range studied, its interval and p-value on the set-point replicates (the error term PCP-004 names) in adequacy_statement and the residual-error version as the sensitivity of Appendix B; the turbidity-on-target regression is the check of the challenge, not an effect. A p-value printed as '< 0.001' has no float value.

ProcessParameter.target_value and NOR are the set-point and NOR against which the study was planned, unchanged at Version 2.0. ProcessParameter.PAR is the proven acceptable range the report states, with the other parameters at their set-points and at the scale of the study. rationale_for_criticality carries the classification argument of Section 9.

The QualityAttribute records are the five attributes of the attribute table. acceptance_criteria holds the drug substance criterion and what applies at harvest: PCMP-001 sets no intermediate acceptance criterion for the clarified harvest; the aggregate and acidic variant criteria of the production bioreactor output pass through harvest unchanged to the load of Protein A capture and are used only to judge the held clarified harvest; fragments are compared with the drug substance criterion there.

acceptance_criteria (the annex layer): the report prints no criteria-change table and Version 1.0 applied no criterion to this step, so there is no superseded record. The in-force records are the decision criteria of PCP-004 §7 as the report applies them (impurity release for host cell protein and residual DNA, clarification for post-clarification turbidity, product quality for aggregate and, judged the same way, fragments), each anchored on its sentence, and the three criteria the held clarified harvest is judged against, each anchored on its row of the hold judgement.

PerformanceMeasure records: centrate turbidity, post-clarification turbidity (also a parameter of the step, measured not set) and step yield, as set-point means of S-HAR-UNI2 at the scale of the study. Step yield is reported and not gated, and the record names no method for it.

ControlStrategyElement records: the five contributions of Section 10 (the KPPs within their NORs, the turbidity in-process control, no quality attribute controlled at harvest, the hold, and the acidic variant monitoring PCR-003 sets at harvest).

Studies: S-HAR-UNI (Version 1.0, no data in the record), S-HAR-UNI2 and the hold study S-HAR-HLD, which has no hold study type and is recorded as univariate (hold time at two temperatures, factors that are not process parameters). No study carries n_runs, which the corpus test reserves for the seeded DoE designs. The qualification of the scale-down model was not made (PD-004-03) and has no study record.

The schema has no record type for a discrepancy from the plan. PD-004-01 to PD-004-08 are report statements anchored on their rows of the discrepancy register, and the studies they add carry that row as a source reference.

The report raises no deviation: a characterization study is not GMP manufacture. The two events of execution of Version 1.0 are study events under the numbers Version 1.0 gave them (DEV-004-01, DEV-004-02), recorded as Deviation records, the schema's only record type for an event of execution. no_impact_on_conclusions is true for both: S-HAR-UNI has no data in the record and no result of it enters the report.

parameter_impacts_attribute / parameter_does_not_significantly_impact_attribute: one assertion per parameter and per attribute of the clarified harvest (host cell protein, residual DNA, aggregate, fragments), each on its row of the regression table; no slope was detected for any of them. Acidic variants were not measured in S-HAR-UNI2 and have no such assertion.
The report prints no related-documents table; the document relationships are anchored on the sentences that name each document.
rhetorical_spans: authoring/rhetorical/PCR-004.spans.yaml, re-curated against the Version 2.0 text in the same pass as this builder. weak_claims is empty.

process_steps.description: Step 4 of the A-Mab drug substance process, between the production bioreactor and Protein A capture. At commercial scale it is run once per batch on the contents of a 15,000 L production bioreactor: the culture passes a continuous disk-stack centrifuge, a train of depth filters and a sterilizing-grade filter, and the clarified harvest is held until capture. The step removes cells and cell debris. It is not credited with clearing any impurity, and no viral clearance is claimed for it. Its settings change the feed to capture: a clarification that removes less passes more fine material, and an operation that breaks more cells releases more host cell protein and DNA. The drug substance CQA register assigns fragments to the step, because proteases from lysed cells continue to clip the antibody while the clarified harvest is held.

parameters.rationale_for_criticality: Classified KPP under SOP-4001 by the rule of PCMP-001 §7.7: it changed the clarity of the feed to capture and no effect on a quality attribute or on step yield was detected. Across its proven acceptable range of 6,000–12,000 g centrate turbidity changed by −78.7 NTU and post-clarification turbidity by −0.69 NTU, with every result below the clarification limit; across the NOR the change in post-clarification turbidity is smaller than the repeatability limit of the turbidity method. The margin of the range to the NOR is 2,000 g at each end. The class rests on host cell protein, residual DNA, aggregate and fragments in the clarified harvest.
